title: An Old Man at the Altar
paragraphs: Zechariah was a priest, and he and his wife Elizabeth were both old, kind and faithful. They had always wished for a child, but it never happened. One day, as Zechariah served in the temple, an angel appeared. The angel told him not to be afraid: his prayer had been heard, Elizabeth would have a son, and he was to call him John, who would get people ready for the Lord. Zechariah could hardly believe it. "How can I be sure of this?" The angel said, "I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God." And because Zechariah doubted, he could not speak until the baby was born. Months later, when asked the baby's name, Zechariah wrote, "His name is John." Suddenly his voice came back, in praise.
wonder: I wonder what Zechariah thought about in all those quiet months?
activity: Try a "silent hour" or a no-talking game, then talk about how it felt.
prayer: God who answers prayer in your own time, give us patience and faith. Amen.
alt: An old priest at a temple altar sees a tall golden angel appearing in the rising incense smoke.
hidden: A tiny scroll with the name "John" (or just a scribbled line).
translation: Retold in our own words, with short quotations from the World English Bible.
